- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/188_P32.23a__post-evaluation-release-candidate.md`
- **Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/188_P32.23a__post-evaluation-release-candidate.md live_verification=false`
- **Base:** `a33cd6e` (the P32.22 tip `devin/p32-22-bounded-recovery` — PR #179)
- **Branch:** `devin/p32-23a-release-candidate`
- **Config:** implement-spec full rigor; `live_verification=false` — fixture/test-PG
  only; NO production candidate, no publication/pointer change, no HG gate tick, no
  human label, no evaluation decision fabricated.
- **Requirement ids:** SIG-TRUST-010
- **ADR:** ADR-142 (the release candidate under deferred evaluation — one pinned
  `sig.candidate-identity/1`, the changed-input stop, unpublished-by-construction

- **Gate:** the S3 human-evaluation spine (HUMAN-H4 → P32.22a → HUMAN-H5 → P32.23)
  is **deferred wholesale by explicit operator choice 2026-10-19** (GATE DECISIONS)
  — *"let's defer all the human review steps and proceed"* — so this ticket runs
  under **amended scope**: there is NO final evaluation decision; the candidate
  builds under the active PROVISIONAL resolution policy with the deferral
  disclosed everywhere the candidate is described. The live stage stays
  operator-gated: `D-R10-LIVE-1` remains **OPEN** — this run lands the machinery +
  fixture candidate only; `D-P32.23a-1` (new) owns the production build.

## Requirements (contract)

1. Rematerialize the selected (or safely demoted) rules against the frozen
   approved inputs in dependency order; append execution completion and preserve
   the audit history.
2. Regenerate all candidate compartments — graph, dossier answers, search
   indexes, specific records, tiles and analytics — under **one** consistent
   ruleset/evaluation/snapshot identity across every affected artifact.
3. Produce the final unpublished change/suppression/evaluation disclosure +
   rollback packet + evidence the publication pointer is unchanged.
4. Refuse changed-input reuse — a changed input affecting sample population or
   semantics stops for explicit reassessment; pre-evaluation previews cannot
   satisfy release acceptance.
5. (Amended scope) Failed or inconclusive evaluation ⇒ safe
   provisional/review-only disclosures; previously optimistic resolved counts
   cannot be reused; the candidate stays unpublished and review-only.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No artifact cites pre-evaluation preview identities; cross-artifact
      manifests agree on the same ruleset/evaluation/snapshot identity.
- [ ] `+0` rematerialization proven; execution completion appended; history
      append-only.
- [ ] Deferred/inconclusive evaluation produces safe provisional/review-only
      disclosures; `eval-confidence/1` stays `mode=shadow`, `applied=[]`; no
      optimistic resolved count reused.
- [ ] Changed input affecting the sample population or semantics stops for
      reassessment (`changed_input` refuse).
- [ ] Publication pointer unchanged (byte-checked); candidate unpublished.
- [ ] Verification green; meaningful tests for every new behavior; requirement
      ids stamped in PR; non-verifiable items have owned DEFERRALS rows +
      compensating controls; ADR-142 for the new decisions; closeout protocol
      followed.

## Plan

Design decision (recorded in ADR-142): **one** candidate, built once, everything
else a projection of one identity —

- **`sig.candidate-identity/1`** (`ops.release_candidate.candidate_identity`) —
  pins `provisional-ruleset/1`, the frozen `sig.repaired-snapshot/1` digest +
  population digest, `code_commit`, and the honest evaluation block
  (`status=deferred`, `decision=null`, `basis=provisional-policy`,
  `policy_id=eval-confidence/1`, `mode=shadow`, `applied=[]`, verbatim deferral
  note + `EVAL_DISCLOSURE`) plus `published/provisional/review_only` and a
  deterministic `identity_digest`. The provisional basis is the identity itself.
- **Changed-input stop** (`verify_population_frame`) — the frame's recorded
  `claim_ids` are reloaded through `db.evidence_audit.load_audit_input` and the
  shared `publication-eligibility/1` selector; a missing claim, population-digest
  drift, or eligibility-set drift raises `changed_input` before any write.
- **`sig.candidate-materialization/1`** (`run_candidate_materialization`) — the
  six shared materializers in recorded dependency order, then a `+0`-verified
  rerun; the execution mints `ingest_run` (`connector_name=sig.release-candidate`,
  `ruleset_version=provisional-ruleset/1`, identity/snapshot/plan input digests)
  and appends `ingest_run_completion` (`ok`, or `failed` recorded before the
  refusal is raised).
- **Unpublished-by-construction staging** — `run_spine_export` (one REPEATABLE
  READ READ ONLY snapshot, `provisional-ruleset/1`, deferral note) →
  `build_release` (the real `r/<pub>` namespace, descriptor, integrity manifest)
  → `validate_release`. `activate()`/`rollback()` are never called;
  `latest.json` is read before/after and a drift raises `pointer_mutation`.
- **`sig.candidate-disclosure/1`** — recorded change facts + suppression facts
  (from the export's own `exclusions.json`) + the verbatim `EVAL_DISCLOSURE`;
  `resolved_sites_figure` parses only this build's `web/coverage.json` and
  refuses a population-total metric (`optimistic_count`).
- **`sig.candidate-rollback/1`** (`prepared_not_needed`) + **`candidate-return-pass/1`**
  (`prepared_not_executed`) + **`sig.candidate-manifest/1`** — the roll-up
  P32.24 validates.
- **CLI** — additive `sig-ops release-candidate` (dsn, frozen snapshot, plan +
  audit + apply report, out dir, registry dir, optional `as_of`/`code_commit`).
- **Committed artifacts** — `docs/build/reports/p32.23a-release-candidate/`:
  candidate manifest/disclosure/materialization/rollback/return-pass (json+md),
  `candidate_export/`, `candidate_release/`, `_regen_snapshot/`, README.
